description: Pure DATA + rule definitions. A finite configuration set S = {0,1}^N on a ring of N cells. A 'constraint' is a survivor-set restriction X -> {x in X : admit(x, X)} where admit may read the RUNNING survivor set X. The question this fixture answers: for which NATURAL families of survivor-set-reactive local rules does APPLYING TWO CONSTRAINTS IN DIFFERENT ORDER land on DIFFERENT survivor sets (restriction-noncommutation)? No precomputed counts are stored here; each leg derives them. The four rule families and the isolating control are defined purely (no project nicknames).
configuration_space: S = {0,1}^N, cells indexed 0..N-1 on a ring (index arithmetic mod N).

window_alphabet.windows: each window w is a cell-set obtained from a nonempty subset T of the offsets as { (c+o) mod N : ... }; concretely the rule's cell-set comp(w) = sorted({ o mod N : o in T }). Distinct cell-sets are deduplicated. The generic scan ranges over ALL unordered pairs (a,b) of distinct windows -- no window pair is hand-selected.
window_alphabet.scan: all unordered pairs (a,b), a<b, of the deduplicated window cell-sets

constraint_as_survivor_restriction: step(rule, X) = [ x in X : admit_rule(x, X) ]. Applying rule_a then rule_b to S means step(rule_b, step(rule_a, S)).

running_mean_threshold.role: candidate state-reactive cut (survivor-set-state-dependent admission via a NON-MONOTONE aggregate)
running_mean_threshold.admit: x admitted iff count1(x, comp) >= theta where count1(x, comp) = |{ i in comp : x_i = 1 }| and theta = the REAL-VALUED mean over y in X of count1(y, comp) (NO ROUNDING). theta READS THE RUNNING SURVIVOR SET X. As X contracts, theta shifts, so order can matter. NOTE: an earlier round()-based threshold was convention-fragile (floor->0, ceil->62, banker's-round->44) -- a defect the full-fleet audit caught; the real-valued mean removes that artifact.
running_mean_threshold.expectation_hint: running-X: ADMITS order-dependent terminal sets (noncommutes) on a generic fraction of window pairs (62/105 with >=, 64/105 with >); to be DERIVED by each leg, not asserted here. This is order-dependent filtering under a natural state-reactive cut -- NOT 'emergence' (that label was fleet-rejected).

ensemble_consistency_majority.admit: x admitted iff for every cell c: x_c equals the majority value of cell c among { y in X : y agrees with x on (c+comp) excluding c }; ties / empty conditioning leave cell c unconstrained.

competitive_exclusion.admit: x admitted iff there is no y in X with y agreeing with x on all cells OUTSIDE comp and strictly more 1s than x INSIDE comp.

minority_frustration.role: confluence control (anti-majority of the running ensemble)
minority_frustration.admit: x admitted iff for every cell c: x_c equals the MINORITY value of cell c among { y in X : y agrees with x on (c+comp) excluding c }; ties / empty leave cell c unconstrained.

isolating_control.name: fixed_reference
isolating_control.definition: Replace every read of the RUNNING survivor set X inside admit_rule by a read of a FIXED reference set R = S (the full configuration space). admit_rule becomes a STATIC predicate on x, so step_R(rule_b, step_R(rule_a, S)) = S intersect P_a intersect P_b is order-independent.
isolating_control.claim: fixed_reference noncommutation count is 0 for every family. This shows dependence on the RUNNING survivor set is NECESSARY for the order-dependence.
isolating_control.tautology_caveat: the full-fleet audit correctly noted this control is PARTLY A TAUTOLOGY: static predicates commute by set-intersection, so 0 is mathematically guaranteed and cannot fail. It therefore CONFIRMS necessity of running-set dependence; it is NOT independent causal evidence. The non-trivial content is the NECESSARY-NOT-SUFFICIENT pair: floor(mean) and three other natural state-reactive families read the running set yet are confluent.

invariant_to_agree_on.running_mean_threshold_fixed_reference_n: DERIVED per leg (MUST be 0 = isolator holds)
invariant_to_agree_on.robustness: the running-X noncommute count is checked at N in {5,6,7}

earns: a NARROW, fleet-survived fact: under a natural state-reactive cut (survive iff at/above the running average density), survivor-set descent ADMITS order-dependent terminal sets (restriction-noncommutation) for a generic 62/105 fraction of window pairs, convention-free (no rounding). State-dependence on the running set is NECESSARY (fixed_reference commutes -- partly tautological) and NOT SUFFICIENT (floor(mean) + three natural state-reactive families are confluent), which REFUTES 'any state-reactive threshold trivially noncommutes.'
does_not_earn: the 'emergence' label (full-fleet audit MIXED verdict, 6/7 returning verdicts rejected/weakened it; held divergence: gemini-3.1-pro alone called it justified); a full ratchet (strict-decrease + termination + distinct terminal sets under distinct schedules); a purely-local-neighborhood rule (the threshold reads a GLOBAL aggregate); a causal 'engine'; any GNVW / bridge / manifold / axis claim.

Arbiter (codex2): MIXED, noncommutation REAL, emergence overclaimed, rounding artifact + isolator-tautology confirmed. See FLEET_VERDICT_20260614.md.

lineage.root_axiom: a = a iff a ~ b -- identity is the survivor class under the active constraints; here the constraint is a survivor-set restriction.
lineage.deeper_engine: order-sensitivity is intrinsic to X_{k+1} = { x in X_k : C(x, X_k) } when C reads the RUNNING set X_k via a non-monotone aggregate; history-dependence (R3) is one special case of this, not the only source.
lineage.exclusion_first: constraints eliminate configurations that cannot persist; they do not generate configurations.
